## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.1-1

### Cloud Credential Alignment
- Uses the X-Sense app's server-selected Cognito Identity credential flow for AWS device-shadow access when the account enables it.
- Keeps the existing legacy credential path for accounts that are not enabled for the newer flow.
- Clears identity credentials when the Cognito ID token changes so later shadow requests obtain credentials for the current session.

### Camera Reliability
- Uses UTC consistently when evaluating X-Sense WebRTC ticket expiry.

### Regression Coverage
- Adds coverage for identity-enabled and legacy accounts, token rotation, and the exact app request shape used to select the credential flow.

This is a pre-release. Latest stable remains v1.6.0.
